assertion: just 2.7% of bridges in Hampton Roads are currently classified as being in poor condition, a significant improvement from 2017, when more than 5% fell into that category.
warehouse_value: 2025: 34 of 1,271 NBI record_type=1 bridges in 16 Hampton Roads localities = 2.68%; 2017: 62 of 1,240 = 5.0%
independent_value: HRTPO report p.22: 34 bridges (2.7%) Aug 2025; 69 (5.5%) in 2017
sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition IN ('Poor','P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM transport.bridges WHERE state_code='51' AND record_type='1' AND county_code IN ('550','650','700','710','740','800','810','830','735','073','093','095','199','181','175','620') GROUP BY year

assertion: With roughly 1,300 bridges across the region
From 2015 to 2024, air travel out of Hampton Roads rose by 46%
warehouse_value: T-100 domestic departing passengers ORF+PHF: 1,733,373 (2015) to 2,541,047 (2024) = +46.6%; 2019-2024 +13.9%. PHF fell 202,509 to 69,342 while ORF grew 61%
sql: SELECT year, origin, SUM(passengers) FROM transport.t100_segments WHERE origin IN ('ORF','PHF') AND year IN (2015,2019,2024) GROUP BY year, origin

assertion: travelers lost an average of 17 hours
inaccuracy: HRTPO (TomTom) gives 17 hours for 2024, not 2023 as the article states
independent_value: HRTPO p.32: 17 hours lost in 2024, slightly below comparable metros (27th of 41)
searched: Hampton Roads hours lost to congestion TomTom
measure: Hampton Roads hours lost to congestion

assertion: Traffic fatalities in the region remain higher than they were a decade ago, though recent trends offer some cautious optimism.
independent_value: HRTPO p.37: 153 deaths in 2024, down from record 179 in 2021, up 26% over decade

assertion: Rail travel has also expanded, with the Norfolk Amtrak station adding a third daily train in recent years
inaccuracy: Report says the third Norfolk-DC train is to be temporarily replaced by a bus because of construction constraints

assertion: including the addition of international flights to destinations like Cancun
inaccuracy: Report: Breeze weekly Norfolk-Cancun begins January 2026; one destination named
independent_value: HRTPO p.14; WTKR related story on first nonstop international flight in 25 years

assertion: the amount of traffic we have on our roadways is still about 4% lower than what we saw prior to the pandemic.
speaker: Keith Nichols
inaccuracy: HRTPO report says regional VMT has returned to pre-pandemic levels (VDOT) and VMT per capita is -0.4% vs 2019; count-station volumes fell 0.6% in 2023-24. The 4% found in the report is unrelated.
why_not: The '4%' hit on report page 13 refers to airport passengers, not roadway traffic; roadway pages 26-28 say VMT returned to pre-pandemic levels.
measure: Hampton Roads vehicle miles traveled traffic volume
